printed: WHO Editorial Style Monval Interferons Interferons are represented by the symbol IFN to which is attached by a hyphen the Greek letter representing its type, for example IFN-a for alpha interferons. Non-allelic variants can be indicated by an arabic number or capital letter (sometimes subscripted) attached to the Greek letter. The prefixes “Hu” and “Mu” may be used to represent “human” and “murine” respectively. For example: MulFN-y HulFN-B — HulFN-c4. Interferon nomenclature. Journal of immunology, 1980, 125:2353.
